name: Fundamentals
description: TypeScript basics, benefits, compiler, language overview, and comparison with JavaScript.

name: Basic Types
description: Primitive types, arrays, tuples, enums, any, unknown, never, void, literal types, and basic typing.

name: Advanced Types
description: Union types, intersection types, mapped types, conditional types, indexed access types, template literal types, and advanced type manipulation.

name: Interfaces & Type Aliases
description: Interfaces, type aliases, declaration merging, extending types, structural typing, and choosing between interfaces and types.

name: Functions
description: Typing functions, overloads, optional parameters, generics in functions, this typing, and function signatures.

name: Generics
description: Generic functions, generic interfaces, generic constraints, utility patterns, and reusable typed abstractions.

name: Utility Types
description: Partial, Required, Pick, Omit, Record, Exclude, Extract, ReturnType, Parameters, and other built-in utility types.

name: Classes
description: TypeScript classes, access modifiers, abstract classes, implements, inheritance, decorators (if applicable), and OOP features.

name: Modules
description: Modules, namespaces, declaration files, imports, exports, ambient declarations, and module resolution.

name: Configuration
description: tsconfig.json, compiler options, strict mode, path aliases, project references, build configuration, and tooling.

name: TypeScript with JavaScript
description: JavaScript interoperability, migration strategies, JSDoc typing, third-party libraries, and integration with existing JavaScript projects.

name: Other
description: Questions that do not clearly belong to any category above.
